say:1:1620127001:1.text: Did you find it? Don't worry if you didn't! I can come with you to help!
say:1:1620127001:1.source_cn: 怎么样，找到魔药的配方了吗？没找到也没关系，我可以去图...

say:2:1620127002:1.text: Chippy can tell you just wanted a trip to the library!
say:2:1620127002:1.source_cn: 满满看出来了，你就是想去莱希拉姆的图书馆！

choice_prompt:3:1620127002.text: Chippy can tell you just wanted a trip to the library!
choice_prompt:3:1620127002.source_cn: 满满看出来了，你就是想去莱希拉姆的图书馆！

narration:4:1620127003:1.text: You read aloud the contents of Anathyme's diary...
narration:4:1620127003:1.male: You read aloud the contents of Anathyme's diary...
narration:4:1620127003:1.female: You read aloud the contents of Anathyme's diary...

say:5:1620127004:3.text: It turns out Professor Anathyme had perfected the recipe, but she never gave the potion to Rocky! She was worried it might harm its health…
say:5:1620127004:3.source_cn: 原来教授不是没有研究出可以让猫安静下来的魔药，而是因为...

say:6:1620127005:1.text: She even made cat food that boosted Rocky's appetite... She absolutely adored the cat!
say:6:1620127005:1.source_cn: 而且她还那么用心地给小石头起名字，为它研究能增长食欲的...

say:7:1620127006:2.text: If that's the case, why did she end up giving Rocky away?
say:7:1620127006:2.source_cn: 既然这样，亚娜奇卡教授最后为什么还要把小石头送走？

say:8:1620127007:1.text: Maybe Rocky's behavior was getting in the way of her research.
say:8:1620127007:1.source_cn: 难道是因为小石头实在是太吵了，打扰她的研究，让她最后实...

say:9:1620127008:1.text: Hmm... that's possible. After all, studying magic takes complete focus.
say:9:1620127008:1.source_cn: 唔……也有可能。毕竟，魔法研究需要全神贯注。

say:10:1620127009:1.text: Especially for alchemists. They're very particular about their research environments, and some complex experiments even require complete silence.
say:10:1620127009:1.source_cn: 尤其是炼金术士，他们对研究环境的要求格外高，一些精密的...

say:11:1620127010:1.text: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!
say:11:1620127010:1.source_cn: 主人，你做实验的时候，满满一定会保持安静的！
say:11:1620127010:1.male: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!
say:11:1620127010:1.female: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!

choice_prompt:12:1620127010.text: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!
choice_prompt:12:1620127010.source_cn: 主人，你做实验的时候，满满一定会保持安静的！
choice_prompt:12:1620127010.male: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!
choice_prompt:12:1620127010.female: Magister, Chippy promises to stay quiet while you're doing your experiments!

say:13:1620127011:2.text: Silly Chippy! <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never give us away!
say:13:1620127011:2.male: Silly Chippy! <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never give us away!
say:13:1620127011:2.female: Silly Chippy! <style="stress"><player_name></style> would never give us away!

say:14:1620127012:2.text: Forget it. We won't figure out the reason just by racking our brains, right?
say:14:1620127012:2.source_cn: 算啦，既然想不出原因……那就不想了！

say:15:1620127013:1.text: Let's bring the recipe to the professor! Once she has modified it, we can give the potion to Rocky.
say:15:1620127013:1.source_cn: 走吧，我们去墓园把配方带给教授！等配方改良好了，小石头...

choice:12:0:1.text: Relax, I won't give you away.
choice:12:0:1.male: Relax, I won't give you away.
choice:12:0:1.female: Relax, I won't give you away.

choice:12:1:2.text: I need both hamsters with me!
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 两只仓鼠，一只都不能少！
choice:12:1:2.male: I need both hamsters with me!
choice:12:1:2.female: I need both hamsters with me!
